messages:
zoe: heads-up: publish blocked for samplekit. regen-diff shows a rename from authRetry -> authRetries and tests asserting exponential backoff are failing. CI stuck. @vik @rana

vik: can you paste the failing diff & test failure?

zoe: ci output:
ci-bot: [build 5389] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

zoe: ```diff
--- a/src/client.ts
+++ b/src/client.ts
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
+  authRetries?: number;
```

rana: ack. did someone bump @redwood/typegen in the monorepo?

devx-bot: @redwood/samplekit and @redwood/devtools reference @redwood/typegen@3.2.0-candidate in workspace devDeps.

vik: issue seems twofold: (1) semantics changed in a minor bump (boolean -> number & backoff behavior), (2) nondet ordering across mac/arm vs linux/x64 created a regen diff. changelog didn't surface the behavioral change.

zoe: short-term: pin typegen to 3.1.x in SDKs and push hotfix to unblock. long-term: add a pre-publish heuristic to detect renamed fields related to auth/retry/backoff and require a changelog entry.

rana: agreed. i've opened hotfix branch samplekit/pin-typegen-3.1 and updated package-lock. running CI.

ci-bot: rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5390 :rocket:

vik: please open a devex issue with repro steps (arm vs x64), suggested lint heuristic, and request to run linux-x64 typegen on CI to avoid platform diffs.

zoe: filed devex#438 "typegen: detect auth/retry renames and run linux-x64 regen in CI" with logs and a proposed heuristic. linking PR when CI green.

rana: if hotfix passes we'll do a patch release and follow up with a minor that intentionally migrates API and documents migration guide for customers. also add a note in the release playbook to run typegen in CI container (linux-x64) before tagging.

vik: good plan. also consider adding a unit test in sample apps that validates public SDK surface (avoid asserting internal retry impl details) so future semantic tweaks don't flake consumer tests.

zoe: thanks — will update tests and the playbook once patch is on main. :white_check_mark:
